title: On-Ball Containment to the Sideline
description: A defender practises funnelling a ball handler toward the sideline rather than letting them attack the middle of the floor.

content.objective: Keep the ball handler out of the middle of the floor by taking away the inside angle.
content.setup: A ball handler faces a defender near the top of the key, free to attack either direction.
instructions: The defender overplays the middle slightly, inviting the drive toward the sideline.
The ball handler attacks at game speed in either direction.
The defender slides to stay in front, always protecting the middle of the floor.
Rotate ball handlers every six reps.
coachingPoints: Keep the inside foot and hand slightly ahead to protect the middle.
Stay low and slide — don't turn the hips to run.
Communicate 'I've got ball' to teammates throughout.
commonMistakes: Squaring up straight on instead of angling the body to funnel.
Reaching in instead of using the feet to stay in front.
Watching the ball only and losing track of the opponent.
content.safety: The ball handler should not initiate contact to create space.
